title: Wish / If only
use_hint: Fix the sentence · Enter = check · Enter = next
note: B2 grammar unit, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane, replacing the empty shell. 30 items, inside the 24-40 band. b1_wishes owns *wish* + past simple (present regret, 25 items) and its target error *I wish I have*; this unit deliberately does NOT re-teach that pattern as a bank — it appears once, as the first Use item, so the recap is a check rather than a repeat. The two genuinely new shapes get a block each: PAST REGRET, *wish/if only* + had + past participle (14), and WANTING SOMEONE TO CHANGE, *wish/if only* + would (10). *If only* is woven through both rather than given its own block, because it is the same grammar at a higher temperature. Answers are varied on purpose — had, had not, If only, would — so the student cannot pass the unit by typing one word every time. D1: every item carries its own explanation naming its own verb. A8 accepts are generated as a full contraction closure. Distractors stay on the axis and carry the unit's real errors (B4): *have* and *will* after *wish*, which are the two commonest Czech-learner mistakes here. Use is error-correction (E7), one error each (E2), including the *I wish I would* self-reference error which needs **could**. ABSORPTION: B2-PLAN has this unit absorb `b2_hypothetical_past`; that node's stub is left untouched, since parking it is a registry edit and a hard never for this lane — logged in DECISIONS.md. KWT: this unit is KWT-native per FCE-EXERCISES.md, but that needs a js/ branch which is James-only under P-engine, so Use is ordinary error-correction.

cards.title: Wish / If only
points: *Wish* and *if only* say that reality is **not** what you want.
English shows this by stepping the verb one tense **further back**.
*If only* is the same grammar, said more strongly.

cards.title: You already know
cards.title_cz: Už znáš — I wish + minulý čas
points: Wishes 1 taught the **present** regret: step back one tense.
Now come the **past** regret and the **would** complaint.

cards.title: Wishing about the past
points: Regret about something finished: **had** + past participle.
It is the same step-back, taken from the past instead of the present.

rows: She wishes she **had taken** the other one.
I wish I **had not** said that.

cards.title: Wishing someone would change
points: **would** + verb, when somebody else keeps doing something annoying.
About **yourself**, use *could* — you cannot wish your own behaviour into changing.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: Every one of these is the tense failing to step back.

items.en: I wish I had studied harder at school.
items.cz: Kéž bych se ve škole učil víc.
items.gap: I wish I ____ studied harder at school.
accepts: I wish I'd studied harder at school.
I wish I had studied harder at school.
I wish I would studied harder at school.
items.explanation: Regret about a finished past takes **had** + past participle — *had studied*.
items.explanation_cz: Lítost nad uzavřenou minulostí má **had** + příčestí minulé — *had studied*.

items.en: I wish I had not said that to her.
items.cz: Kéž bych jí to byl neřekl.
items.gap: I wish I ____ said that to her.
accepts: I wish I'd not said that to her.
I wish I hadn't said that to her.
I wish I had not said that to her.
I wish I wouldn't said that to her.
I wish I would not said that to her.
items.explanation: The regret is negative, so **had not** said. *Hadn't* is the same answer.
items.explanation_cz: Lítost je záporná, proto **had not** said. *Hadn't* je totéž.

items.en: She wishes she had taken the other job.
items.cz: Kéž by byla vzala tu druhou práci.
items.gap: She wishes she ____ taken the other job.
accepts: She wishes she'd taken the other job.
She wishes she had taken the other job.
She wishes she would taken the other job.
items.explanation: **had** taken — the choice is closed, so the wish shifts one step further back.
items.explanation_cz: **had** taken — volba je uzavřená, proto se přání posune o krok zpět.

items.en: If only we had left the house earlier.
items.cz: Kéž bychom byli vyšli z domu dřív.
items.gap: If only we ____ left the house earlier.
accepts: If only we'd left the house earlier.
If only we had left the house earlier.
If only we would left the house earlier.
items.explanation: *If only* is the stronger *I wish*, and it takes the same **had** + past participle.
items.explanation_cz: *If only* je silnější *I wish* a má stejné **had** + příčestí minulé.

items.en: I wish they had told me about the change.
items.cz: Kéž by mi byli o té změně řekli.
items.gap: I wish they ____ told me about the change.
accepts: I wish they'd told me about the change.
I wish they had told me about the change.
I wish they would told me about the change.
items.explanation: **had** told — you are looking back at something they did not do.
items.explanation_cz: **had** told — díváš se zpět na něco, co neudělali.

items.en: He wishes he had learned to drive younger.
items.cz: Kéž by se byl naučil řídit dřív.
items.gap: He wishes he ____ learned to drive younger.
accepts: He wishes he'd learned to drive younger.
He wishes he had learned to drive younger.
He wishes he would learned to drive younger.
items.explanation: **had** learned. The learning never happened, and that time is gone.
items.explanation_cz: **had** learned. K učení nedošlo a ten čas je pryč.

items.en: If only she had listened to her parents.
items.cz: Kéž by byla poslechla rodiče.
items.gap: If only she ____ listened to her parents.
accepts: If only she'd listened to her parents.
If only she had listened to her parents.
If only she would listened to her parents.
items.explanation: **had** listened — one finished moment she cannot go back to.
items.explanation_cz: **had** listened — jeden uzavřený okamžik, ke kterému se nedá vrátit.

items.en: I wish I had never sold that car.
items.cz: Kéž bych to auto nikdy nebyl prodal.
items.gap: I wish I ____ never sold that car.
accepts: I wish I'd never sold that car.
I wish I had never sold that car.
I wish I would never sold that car.
items.explanation: **had** never sold — *never* sits between *had* and the participle.
items.explanation_cz: **had** never sold — *never* stojí mezi *had* a příčestím.

items.en: We wish we had booked a bigger room.
items.cz: Kéž bychom si byli zamluvili větší pokoj.
items.gap: We wish we ____ booked a bigger room.
accepts: We wish we'd booked a bigger room.
We wish we had booked a bigger room.
We wish we would booked a bigger room.
items.explanation: **had** booked — the booking is done and cannot change.
items.explanation_cz: **had** booked — rezervace je hotová a nedá se změnit.

items.en: If only I had known about the meeting.
items.cz: Kéž bych byl o té schůzi věděl.
items.gap: If only I ____ known about the meeting.
accepts: If only I'd known about the meeting.
If only I had known about the meeting.
If only I would known about the meeting.
items.explanation: **had** known — *If only* is the strongest form, and takes the same past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: **had** known — *If only* je nejsilnější podoba a má stejný předminulý čas.

items.en: They wish they had stayed one more night.
items.cz: Kéž by byli zůstali ještě jednu noc.
items.gap: They wish they ____ stayed one more night.
accepts: They wish they'd stayed one more night.
They wish they had stayed one more night.
They wish they would stayed one more night.
items.explanation: **had** stayed — the trip is over, so the wish is past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: **had** stayed — výlet skončil, proto je přání v předminulém čase.

items.en: I wish he had asked me first.
items.cz: Kéž by se mě byl nejdřív zeptal.
items.gap: I wish he ____ asked me first.
accepts: I wish he'd asked me first.
I wish he had asked me first.
I wish he would asked me first.
items.explanation: **had** asked. He did not ask, and the moment has passed.
items.explanation_cz: **had** asked. Nezeptal se a ten okamžik minul.

items.en: She wishes she had not spent so much money.
items.cz: Kéž by byla neutratila tolik peněz.
items.gap: She wishes she ____ spent so much money.
accepts: She wishes she'd not spent so much money.
She wishes she hadn't spent so much money.
She wishes she had not spent so much money.
She wishes she wouldn't spent so much money.
She wishes she would not spent so much money.
items.explanation: **had not** spent — regret that something DID happen takes the negative.
items.explanation_cz: **had not** spent — lítost, že se něco stalo, má zápor.

items.en: If only he had answered the phone.
items.cz: Kéž by byl zvedl telefon.
items.gap: If only he ____ answered the phone.
accepts: If only he'd answered the phone.
If only he had answered the phone.
If only he would answered the phone.
items.explanation: **had** answered — a single missed moment in the closed past.
items.explanation_cz: **had** answered — jediný zmeškaný okamžik v uzavřené minulosti.

items.en: I wish you would stop making that noise.
items.cz: Kéž bys přestal dělat ten rámus.
items.gap: I wish you ____ stop making that noise.
accepts: I wish you'd stop making that noise.
I wish you had stop making that noise.
I wish you would stop making that noise.
items.explanation: **would** — you want somebody else to change their behaviour. Never *will* after *wish*.
items.explanation_cz: **would** — chceš, aby někdo jiný změnil chování. Po *wish* nikdy *will*.

items.en: I wish it would stop raining.
items.cz: Kéž by přestalo pršet.
items.gap: I wish it ____ stop raining.
accepts: I wish it would stop raining.
items.explanation: **would** stop — an annoying situation you want changed.
items.explanation_cz: **would** stop — otravná situace, kterou chceš změnit.

items.en: She wishes her neighbours would be quieter.
items.cz: Kéž by byli sousedi tišší.
items.gap: She wishes her neighbours ____ be quieter.
accepts: She wishes her neighbours would be quieter.
items.explanation: **would** be — she wants them to act differently, so it is the *would* pattern.
items.explanation_cz: **would** be — chce, aby se chovali jinak, proto vzorec s *would*.

items.en: If only he would listen to me.
items.cz: Kéž by mě poslouchal.
items.gap: If only he ____ listen to me.
accepts: If only he'd listen to me.
If only he had listen to me.
If only he would listen to me.
items.explanation: **would** listen — *If only* takes *would* for the same complaint.
items.explanation_cz: **would** listen — *If only* má *would* u stejné stížnosti.

items.en: I wish they would answer my emails.
items.cz: Kéž by odpovídali na moje e-maily.
items.gap: I wish they ____ answer my emails.
accepts: I wish they'd answer my emails.
I wish they had answer my emails.
I wish they would answer my emails.
items.explanation: **would** answer — a repeated habit of theirs that annoys you.
items.explanation_cz: **would** answer — jejich opakovaný zvyk, který tě štve.

items.en: I wish my computer would work properly.
items.cz: Kéž by ten počítač fungoval pořádně.
items.gap: I wish my computer ____ work properly.
accepts: I wish my computer would work properly.
items.explanation: **would** work — the *would* pattern also covers machines that misbehave.
items.explanation_cz: **would** work — vzorec s *would* platí i pro stroje, které zlobí.

items.en: She wishes her brother would not interrupt her.
items.cz: Kéž by ji bratr nepřerušoval.
items.gap: She wishes her brother ____ not interrupt her.
accepts: She wishes her brother wouldn't interrupt her.
She wishes her brother would not interrupt her.
items.explanation: **would** not interrupt — the negative of the same behaviour pattern.
items.explanation_cz: **would** not interrupt — zápor téhož vzorce chování.

items.en: I wish the bus would come on time.
items.cz: Kéž by ten autobus jezdil včas.
items.gap: I wish the bus ____ come on time.
accepts: I wish the bus would come on time.
items.explanation: **would** come — a recurring annoyance, not a one-off past event.
items.explanation_cz: **would** come — opakovaná otrava, ne jednorázová minulá událost.

items.en: If only they would tell us the truth.
items.cz: Kéž by nám řekli pravdu.
items.gap: If only they ____ tell us the truth.
accepts: If only they'd tell us the truth.
If only they had tell us the truth.
If only they would tell us the truth.
items.explanation: **would** tell — you want them to start doing it.
items.explanation_cz: **would** tell — chceš, aby s tím začali.

items.en: I wish you would not talk so loudly.
items.cz: Kéž bys nemluvil tak nahlas.
items.gap: I wish you ____ not talk so loudly.
accepts: I wish you'd not talk so loudly.
I wish you hadn't talk so loudly.
I wish you had not talk so loudly.
I wish you wouldn't talk so loudly.
I wish you would not talk so loudly.
items.explanation: **would** not talk — asking somebody to change, so *would*, never *will*.
items.explanation_cz: **would** not talk — žádáš někoho o změnu, proto *would*, nikdy *will*.

items.en: I wish I had more time.
items.cz: Kéž bych měl víc času.
items.wrong: I wish I have more time.
accepts: I wish I'd more time.
I wish I had more time.
I wish I would more time.
items.explanation: After *wish*, a present regret steps back one tense: **had**, not *have*.
items.explanation_cz: Po *wish* se přítomná lítost posune o čas zpět: **had**, ne *have*.

items.en: I wish I had studied harder at school.
items.cz: Kéž bych se ve škole učil víc.
items.wrong: I wish I would studied harder at school.
accepts: I wish I'd studied harder at school.
I wish I had studied harder at school.
I wish I would studied harder at school.
items.explanation: *Would* never carries a past regret — that is **had** + past participle.
items.explanation_cz: *Would* nikdy nenese lítost nad minulostí — ta má **had** + příčestí minulé.

items.en: I wish you would stop making that noise.
items.cz: Kéž bys přestal dělat ten rámus.
items.wrong: I wish you will stop making that noise.
accepts: I wish you'd stop making that noise.
I wish you had stop making that noise.
I wish you would stop making that noise.
items.explanation: *Will* cannot follow *wish*. Asking someone to change takes **would**.
items.explanation_cz: Po *wish* nemůže být *will*. Žádost o změnu má **would**.

items.en: If only I had known about the meeting.
items.cz: Kéž bych byl o té schůzi věděl.
items.wrong: If only I would known about the meeting.
accepts: If only I'd known about the meeting.
If only I had known about the meeting.
If only I would known about the meeting.
items.explanation: *If only* about the past takes **had** + past participle, exactly like *I wish*.
items.explanation_cz: *If only* o minulosti má **had** + příčestí minulé, přesně jako *I wish*.

items.en: I wish I could stop eating so much.
items.cz: Kéž bych dokázal přestat tolik jíst.
items.wrong: I wish I would stop eating so much.
accepts: I wish I could stop eating so much.
items.explanation: You cannot *wish* yourself into changing — about your own behaviour use **could**.
items.explanation_cz: Sám sebe si *wish* nezměníš — o vlastním chování se říká **could**.

items.en: She wishes she had taken the other job.
items.cz: Kéž by byla vzala tu druhou práci.
items.wrong: She wishes she has taken the other job.
accepts: She wishes she'd taken the other job.
She wishes she had taken the other job.
She wishes she would taken the other job.
items.explanation: *Has taken* is a present perfect. The regret needs the further step back: **had taken**.
items.explanation_cz: *Has taken* je předpřítomný čas. Lítost potřebuje krok dál zpět: **had taken**.
